name: sg-pleat
summary: Full-bleed hero running shader.gallery's pleat: accordion-folded cloth breaking the frame into flat-shaded panels split by hard crease lines, with a broad band of light rolling horizontally across them.

colors.description: Four tints cycled panel to panel through a colour wheel, so all four appear across the frame rather than one owning a corner. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette.

pleatWidth.description: Width of one accordion panel in CSS pixels, normalised against the frame by the shader so a panel keeps its share of the width at any size. Upstream default, range 30 to 300.

rollSpeed.description: Rate the band of light sweeps across the cloth; 0 leaves it parked and the facets still read. Upstream default, range 0 to 2.

sway.description: How far the creases bow and lean over a breath; 0 gives a rigid vertical accordion. Upstream default, range 0 to 1.

deviations.what: The four u_palette tints are ours, not upstream's `glacier` preset.
deviations.why: pleat/meta.json names a palette as a string only; the table it resolves against lives in @shader-gallery/runtime, a package paw-fx does not vendor. Ours is a cool glacier set chosen to match the CSS resting state, which reads the same --fx-c1..--fx-c4.

deviations.what: No post chain: upstream's poster runs bloom 0.4 at radius 3.5, saturation 1.15, contrast 1.12, dither and a 0.28 backdrop over the shader output.
deviations.why: The post chain is also in @shader-gallery/runtime. Our output is the raw shader, so the ridge catch-lights carry no bloom and the section will not match the upstream poster. The CSS grain layer covers the banding the poster's dither was there for.

deviations.what: Rendered through paw-fx's own WebGL runtime (effects/_shared/glsl-mount.js) rather than @shader-gallery/runtime.
deviations.why: Seam. Upstream ships the .frag with no module around it. The GLSL itself is byte-identical to upstream and lives in shader.frag beside index.js.
